facts.business: Filatex India Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of polyester chips, polyester filament yarn, and polypropylene multifilament yarn.

key_risks: Litigation, claims and other contingencies with contingent liabilities of Rs 35,878.48 lakhs relating to tax and legal claims

facts.related_party_note: The Company has invested more than 20% equity capital in power SPVs namely FPEL Sunrise Private Limited and FP Crysta Energy Private Limited to qualify as a captive user. As per shareholding agreement, the Company shall not directly or indirectly take part in financial and operation policy decisions of the Power SPVs. Investments are not considered as investment in associates.
